primary_metric: RMSE on held-out published mean timepoints, percentage points
deduplication: same source formulation identity plus identical times/means: keep first provenance, record aliases
weighting: unweighted; source SD is not a substitute for available raw unit observations and covariance
bounds: free asymptotes 1..150; capped 1..100; fixed100; all rate/shape constraints recorded in code
optimization: deterministic three-start bounded least_squares, best finite converged SSR; tol1e-9 max_nfev2000
model_selection: no candidate chosen as efficacy-best; lowest observed diagnostic error is exploratory, requires external confirmation
